title: Te Kaiwhakakapi i Whakatūria
intro: He tangata nō ngā tau kua pahure ake nei e tū ana, e rite ana ki te takahi i te hītori. I te wā i ahua pōuri te ara, ā, i horapa te ruarua i roto i te iwi, i whiriwhiria tēnei pononga hei tango i te koroka o te arataki. Me te taumaha o te misioni tapu i runga i ō rātou pakihiwi, ka hikoi whakamua rātou ki te ārahi i te wāhi i ruarua ai ētahi atu ki te whai.
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau hei hoa mō tētahi poropiti, ā, i ako ahau i ō rātou whakaaro nui
I tū ahau i mua i te Āka i te taenga mai o te kupu whakaari a tō tātou Kaiwhakaora, ā, ka kite ahau i te iwi e tīmata ana ki te ruarua.
I meinga ahau kia tū ki te taha o te mea i oatitia, i a tō mātou rangatira e pouri ana, e inoi ana ki a Allah mō mātou.
I whakatūria ahau ki te haere tonu i tētahi misioni i tukuna ki tētahi atu i mua i ahau.
I tukua mai ki ahau te mana atua hei arahi i te iwi ki tō rātou ūnga
I angitu ahau ki te whakaoti i ngā mea i tīmata i mua i ahau, ā, i whiwhi ahau i te whakaū a te iwi mō taku arataki.

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
